verdict.summary: The workflow changes correctly bound the nightly Miri and Kani matrix admission rates while preserving fail-fast:false and the complete matrices. The new audit consistently counts capped matrix legs plus plain jobs, enforces per-lane and combined ceilings, rejects critical-path triggers, checks Miri partition coverage, and is wired into docs-quality. Its hermetic, live-workflow, and real-document mutation tests are non-vacuous; all 19 tests pass. No correctness, soundness, security, or test-validity defect was found in the diff.
